gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold states left-sided headache that began upon waking today. Generated cc-001 notes patient presents with a left-sided headache, and hpi-001 notes waking at 05:30 with the headache. Together they capture onset upon waking and left-sided location.

Gold: headache began about 5:30 AM and woke patient. Generated hpi-001: patient awoke at approximately 05:30 with a severe, left-sided headache. Time and the fact that it woke the patient are captured; 'severe' is an added detail but not contradictory.

Gold: headache still present at time of consultation. Generated hpi-001 describes current severe headache as presenting symptom, implying ongoing presence; this reasonably covers persistence, though not explicitly time-stamped.

Gold: history of less-severe frontal headaches in the past. Generated hpi-003 says previous headaches occur as clusters at the front of the head but does not state they were less severe; instead, hpi-002 only says current headache is atypical. The specific qualifier 'less severe' is missing.
Gold: no neck stiffness. Generated hpi-004 (denies neck stiffness) and ros-002 (negative for neck stiffness) both capture this.
Gold: no fever. Generated hpi-005 (denies fever) and ros-003 (negative for fever) capture this.
Gold: some sensitivity to bright lights now. Generated hpi-006: reports sensitivity to bright light, and ros-001: positive for photophobia. Both capture this symptom.
Gold: no nausea now. Generated ros-004: review of systems negative for nausea. That supports current absence of nausea.
Gold: felt dizzy this morning but not now. Generated hpi-007: experienced initial dizziness without nausea. This captures earlier dizziness and implies it was not ongoing (initial).
Gold: headache improves when lying down. Generated hpi-008: headache somewhat alleviates when lying down. Same clinical content.
Gold: paracetamol taken did not help. Generated med-002 and plan-002 mention paracetamol use and continuation, but they do not state it failed to relieve the headache.
Gold: ongoing work stress and late nights for a few months. Generated sh-004 notes work-related stress but omits the duration ('ongoing for a few months') and late nights.
Gold: patient denies thoughts of self-harm. No generated fact mentions self-harm ideation.
Gold: anxiety for 2 years. Generated pmh-001 only notes a history of anxiety without duration.
Gold: otherwise no significant past medical history. No generated fact states that PMH is otherwise nil or unremarkable.
Gold: patient is taking sertraline. Generated med-001 states patient is taking Sertraline. Missing dose/frequency is acknowledged but not required by gold.

Gold: patient has taken paracetamol for current headache. Generated med-002: patient is taking Paracetamol; plan-002: continue Paracetamol. This implies current use for pain relief, covering the fact of use.
Gold: NKDA. Generated allergy-001: no known drug allergies. Same content.

Gold: no family history of migraines. Generated fhx-002: family history negative for migraines or significant physical illnesses. Migraines part is covered; 'significant physical illnesses' is an added element.
Gold: mother has anxiety. Generated fhx-001: mother with a history of anxiety. Same content.
Gold: lives with partner. Generated sh-001: lives with a partner. Same content.
Gold: non-smoker. Generated sh-002: patient is a non-smoker. Same content.
Gold: has a cat at home. No generated fact mentions a pet or cat.

Gold: good exercise and reasonable diet. Generated sh-003: exercises by running three times a week (covers good exercise). sh-005: tries to maintain a balanced diet (approximate to reasonable diet). Together they cover the concepts though phrasing differs.
Gold: work is stressful with late nights at work ongoing for a few months. Generated sh-004 only states work-related stress; it omits late nights and duration (few months).

Gold: impression is tension-type headache with possible migraine (tension +/- migraine). Generated asm-002 and asm-003 list migraine and tension headache as differential diagnoses rather than a combined primary impression. The components are present but framed as differentials, not a single combined impression.
Gold: start ibuprofen as first-line per SIGN 2018 migraine guidelines. Generated plan-001: start ibuprofen but does not reference first-line status or SIGN 2018 migraine guidelines.

Gold: advise hydration of 1.5–2 L water daily. Generated plan-006: hydrate with 1.5–2 liters daily, excluding caffeinated beverages. Base hydration advice is covered; exclusion of caffeine is additional detail.
Gold: recommend 7–8 hours sleep nightly. Generated plan-005: aim for 7–8 hours of sleep per night. Same content.

Gold: consider time off work and self-certify for a few days. Generated plan-007: consider taking time off work to reduce stress. Time off is covered; self-certification and 'few days' duration are omitted.
Gold: patient to self-refer to IAPTs. Generated plan-004 suggests follow-up with a counseling service, but does not specify IAPTs or self-referral.
Gold: review in one week. Generated plan-003 and fu-001 both state follow-up in one week. Covered.

Gold: if any red-flag headache symptoms occur, ring back sooner. Generated plan-008 and plan-009: education on danger signs and encouraging seeking further review if symptoms worsen. This captures the concept of red-flag/danger signs and earlier review, though not the specific reference to patient.co.uk or 'ring back sooner'.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Time and waking from sleep are supported by gold hpi-001; 'severe' is an added descriptor not present in gold.
Gold notes current headache and past less-severe frontal headaches but does not explicitly state that the current headache is 'atypical' compared to prior ones.

Generated: previous headaches usually occur as clusters at the front of the head. Gold: history of headaches less severe and in front of the head, but no mention of cluster pattern. Introducing 'clusters' alters the headache type characterization and is not supported.

Gold: felt dizzy this morning but not now, and separately no nausea now. Generated: initial dizziness without nausea. This conveys early dizziness and absence of nausea, but does not explicitly state resolution of dizziness at present.
Gold includes duration of anxiety (2 years). Generated only states a history of anxiety without duration.
Gold: paracetamol taken for current headache and not helpful. Generated: patient is taking Paracetamol, dose/route/frequency not documented. Use is supported; effectiveness (not helpful) is omitted.
Gold supports 'no family history of migraines'. The added phrase 'or significant physical illnesses' is not present in gold and is therefore an addition.
Gold only states 'good exercise' without specifying running three times a week. The specific modality and frequency are new details.
Gold: work is stressful with late nights ongoing for months. Generated: experiences work-related stress. Stress is supported; late nights and chronicity are omitted.
Gold: reasonable diet. Generated: tries to maintain a balanced diet. Conceptually aligned but framed as an effort rather than a current state.

Generated simply identifies 'Headache' as current problem. Gold assessment explicitly labels type (tension +/- migraine) rather than just naming symptom as problem. This problem-list style entry is not present in gold.

Same as asm-002: tension-type headache is part of the gold impression; listing it as a differential is a different framing but shares the diagnostic content.

Gold: start ibuprofen as first line per SIGN 2018 migraine guidelines. Generated: start ibuprofen, dose/route/frequency not specified. Starting ibuprofen is supported; first-line status and guideline reference are omitted.

Generated: continue Paracetamol as desired for pain relief. Gold: paracetamol taken did not help (hpi-010) and plan focuses on ibuprofen as first line with no suggestion to continue ineffective paracetamol. Recommending continuation of an ineffective medication conflicts with gold’s implication.

Base hydration advice (1.5–2 L daily) matches gold. Excluding caffeinated beverages is an added restriction not specified in gold.
Gold: consider time off work and self-certify for a few days. Generated: consider taking time off work to reduce stress. Time off is supported; self-certification and duration are not mentioned.

Educational content about danger signs is supported; specific URL and 'ring back' instruction are not included here (but partially captured in plan-009).
